name: Monarch Plastics Inc
about:
Monarch Plastics Inc, operating as The Monarch Group, is headquartered in Kenosha, Wisconsin. Founded more than 50 years ago, the company has built a reputation as a specialist in plastic packaging solutions for growing brands and the partners that serve them.

The company designs, tools, and produces custom HDPE containers, PET cans, and a range of stock containers. Its in‑house capabilities include manufacturing, container decoration, and automated palletizing, all supported by vertical integration that allows tooling, development, and production under one roof.

Monarch serves food manufacturers, retail chains, and consumer‑packaged‑goods brands. A vice president of a leading Canadian food manufacturer noted that Monarch’s custom HDPE containers meet the stringent packaging requirements of Canada’s largest retailers, illustrating the company’s reach into North American retail supply chains.

The company emphasizes collaborative, customer‑centric partnerships, industry‑leading lead times enabled by its central North American location, and sustainability initiatives such as clean energy, waste reduction, recycling programs, and optimized designs. Vertical integration is cited as a cost advantage that makes custom packaging more accessible.
